revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: TripPet iOS achievement medal raster art candidate, local-only, later converted into a transparent 768x768 PNG
Asset name: achievement_medal_postcards_tier_002
Primary request: Create one premium collectible postcard achievement medal for tier 2, GREEN rank. Based on the Chinese title concept "些许相知" and subtitle about being dizzy after free tickets. The image itself must contain no text, no numbers, no labels.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #ff00ff chroma-key background for background removal; one uniform color only, no shadows or gradients.
Subject: exactly one centered circular medal. Inside is the same unified funny anthropomorphic postcard/envelope mascot: ivory rounded postcard body, tiny arms and legs, expressive face. Tier 2 gag: the postcard is dizzy and delighted, wobbling with swirly eyes while holding two blank tiny travel-ticket shapes like trophies; tiny heart sparks around it, but no writing on tickets.
Medal border: GREEN rank, second visual level: emerald and mint enamel circular ring with silver trim, simple side clasps, leaf-like small ornaments, no wings, no large outward fins, still mostly circular.
Style/medium: polished 3D-like mobile game collectible, enamel and metal, cute humorous center mascot, crisp small-UI readability, same family as travel and foot medals.
Composition/framing: one centered medal only, full object visible, generous padding, central mascot inside the circular core.
Lighting/mood: bright glossy highlights, goofy romantic dizziness.
Color palette: emerald green and mint border, silver trim, ivory mascot, pastel ticket props; avoid #ff00ff anywhere in subject.
Text: none.
Constraints: no letters, no numbers, no Chinese, no labels, no address lines, no stamp marks, no postmark rings, no watermark, no people, no animals, no suitcase, no shoes, no money pile, no cast shadow, no reflection, do not create multiple medals.
